notes.title: Alpha 0.7.1 Released
notes.content:
[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*]New Stickers and Materials Added
[*]New Timer Block Added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26326320/5e689f52743ee6a9effd2aca7498bb3493f9afa3.gif[/img]
[*]Light objects can now be triggered by logic.
[*]Sound and Music block improvements (with new songs and sound effects!)
[*]Modified player movement (Removed jump delay and speed reduction, and other tweaked values)
[*] New player animations
[*]New mouse grabbing for dynamic materials (ctrl+click to move material the old way)
[*]Updated backgrounds (with lighting and ground changes)
[*]New outfits and player colors
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26326320/ebd2608c86b8b9398b9edb2b70c54829eba790b6.png[/img]
[*]Multiplayer Improvements and Bug Fixes
[*]New Multiplayer Lobby Feature
[*]Local Multiplayer Added (still in early stages of development)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26326320/26be902c5df12f0e804c6ee371c70f8f2631fb9a.png[/img]
[*]Portal Object Added
[*]Wheel Object Added
[*]NPC Bug Fixes
[*]Ball TNT added
[*]2 New Achievements
[*]UI/Menu Improvements and Bug Fixes
[*]Saving and Loading improvements
[*]Added new object translations
[*]Misc. bug fixes
[/list]

[h3]WARNING[/h3]
This update will unfortunately render all level files made with 0.7.0 unreadable. You may still play these levels by switching to the "compatibility branch" for now, but these levels will be deleted in the near future as we get closer to release. This may happen again before release, I apologize for the inconvenience.

[h3]What's Expected in the next update?[/h3]
[list]
[*]Multi Object Selecting and Editing
[*]More Background Themes
[*]Piston editing variables
[*]Improved Multiplayer Syncing
[*]Improved Workshop Support (Level Tags? Publishing/Downloading Grouped Objects?)
[*]Reintroduce the programmable seat object
[*]Particle Emitter
[*]Perhaps demo of first story level/campaign? (Might be moved to next update)
[/list]

To follow this game more closely, keep an eye out for the game's Trello page where I am keeping a consistent feed of new bugs fixed and improvements/features added in each version.
[url=https://trello.com/b/9j9NTuuW/cranium-conundrum]https://trello.com/b/9j9NTuuW/cranium-conundrum[/url]

notes.title: Public Alpha 0.7.0 Update - Changelog
notes.content:
New Features:
[list]
[*] New engine remade in Unity
[*] Steam Workshop included - Uploading/Playing
[*]Dynamic Lighting 
[*]Customizable controls
[*]Translations for Spanish, French, and Russian accessible from the Gameplay Settings.
[*]Connected tile materials
[*]Track Objects added

[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Error message added to levels played on Workshop with incompatible save file version.
[*]Achievement fixes
[*]Rods attached materials now save properly
[/list]

I will now be updating the public branch with additional updates/changes with this version. And I will try my very best to stick to a 2-3 week update schedule on this branch (with the exclusion of hotfix patches). Please submit bugs with a description of how it occurred to http://www.fallingstargames.com/contact-us/. If the bug can be addressed quickly a hotfix patch will be released, otherwise it will be fixed in the next update(s).

notes.title: Cranium Conundrum - Unity (Beta Branch Updates)
notes.content:
Hello fellow Conundrum-ers!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26326320/dbf35bff7c431502a968bf218e8ee31dfac21a5a.png[/img]
With the shift to steam and a more steam integrated focus a new engine was required to progress so unfortunately that has added a big chunk of time to the development time, but I have been hard at work coding to bring you the current state of the new engine on Unity. The game is not at the state the previous version was and is still buggy and missing a lot of features that were once there, but if you'd like to opt-in and try out the new engine with some of the new included features [b](such as Steam Workshop Integration, Multiplayer, and Steam Achievements)[/b].

[u]How do I activate these new updates?[/u]
To enable the beta branch updates, you must  right-click on Cranium Conundrum in your games list in Steam.  Select the "Properties" menu item.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26326320/4398d8e0d98db69ae4f38288fdd50e817aadc15e.png[/img]

In the properties dialog, select the "Betas" tab.  There's a drop-down list that allows you to select the beta branch.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26326320/7e5f57bd71e8490969593427840a89555ed207d9.png[/img]

[b]CAUTION: This beta version is very early in development and expect to experience many bugs and/or crashes. This branch will be updated frequently until all objects are working just as they did in the previous official build.[/b]

notes.title: Alpha 0.6е Changelog
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Multiplayer Sync Fixed
[*]Cloning Logic Tools Added
[*]Cloning Command Blocks now copy Command and Identifier
[*]Motorcycles, Cupcake, and Books can be picked up via Mouse
[*]Cupcake Collision Modified
[*]Jump Physics Improved (non-tap jump now 2 blocks high, but holding jump jumps 3 blocks, ladder jumps nerfed)
[*]Platform Placing Improved (tighter grid, layer support added, angle fix)
[*]Material Placing Improved (angle fix, more back layer sprites added, hold right click to delete)
[*]Logic System Recreated (more reliable)
[*]New Materials Added
[*]Material Designs Modified (Diamond, Black Brick, Base Block, and Red Brick)
[*]Main Menu Design Changes + Temporary Main Menu Music Added
[*]Host Port can be changed via Settings Menu
[*][In-Complete] Sandbox Mode can now be selected in the Main Menu
[*]Misc. Optimizations and Bug Fixes
[/list]
